env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# The const composite write checks run for loGo/s files only: a Go package that calls a mutating pointer method of an exported const composite, writes its slice and uses the mutating builtins on it compiles and prints what Go prints.
cd app
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gohooks$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/gohooks$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../want.txt

-- want.txt --
5 [9 7 3] map[a:1]
-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/ccgolib

go 1.27

-- lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	N int
}

func (b *Box) Set(n int) { b.N = n }

const C = Box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "z": 2}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, N: 7}
-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/ccgoapp

go 1.27

require example.com/ccgolib v0.0.0

replace example.com/ccgolib => ../lib
-- app/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	lib "example.com/ccgolib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.Set(5)
	lib.C.L[0] = 9
	copy(lib.C.L[1:], []int{7})
	delete(lib.C.M, "z")
	fmt.Println(lib.C.N, lib.C.L, lib.C.M)
}
